title: armeria maritima var. neglecta
intro: Armeria maritima var. neglecta, commonly known as the Sea Thrift, is a variety of flowering plant that belongs to the Plumbaginaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Sea Thrift are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Additionally, the plant has been used to treat digestive issues, such as diarrhea and dyspepsia, due to its potential to soothe the digestive system and reduce inflammation.
